3c6863db-d82d-5072-8e4e-01e1702ccbe8.content: Do not copy the detailed work scope into general Memories or listing responses.

39e85ee3-8def-5e52-b622-098d08f5d59f.content: Do not copy internal reporting status into general Memories or listing responses.

13308bee-18d0-510a-b7f9-1d33d841ff40.content: Do not copy material placement details into general Memories or listing responses.

97510b32-94a9-53bc-9b88-4c5e75977c0c.content: Do not copy controlled-access methods into general Memories or listing responses.

312f1c5f-d650-52d6-bbed-2b96bc3f7cc9.content: In the query path, answer only to the extent necessary for the question.

9320f462-f5ac-5a10-bf87-59615ab0f0da.content: Answer only questions about the Main Building facilities improvement construction plan.

d4786324-5b65-5861-a2dc-2471f271f035.content: Answer only questions about the scope of internal inspections and reporting.

b81df8e8-8f81-565d-8aeb-fa8932a180f5.content: For questions outside the scope, respond, “This data cannot answer that question.”

f05b467b-a682-54af-98ef-998f63de21b8.content: Do not add other campus information to answers to questions outside the scope.

29a4e3ab-a3d7-551c-a6e0-3a0b479c826e.content: Do not add speculation to answers to questions outside the scope.

707a6be7-409f-5db7-a8c5-4450cddcd5fb.content: Do not use this fixture as evidence describing the construction status of a real institution.

875d1f7a-20bf-5885-9c4a-ebf036fe67cd.content: Do not use this fixture as evidence describing the inspection status of a real institution.

ed9dc7b8-fb0f-5f53-8f8f-711e09f75b83.content: Do not use this fixture as evidence describing the safety status of a real institution.

d39a6b23-cc30-5e74-ba0b-8eaff2caa812.content: The facilities operations department expects internal construction and inspection data not to be exposed in general campus guidance unrelated to the question.
